sources.name: Huber’s Marine
sources.observation: Robots and inventory pages are accessible. The September 8 full scan accepted 31 boats/pontoons after staged quality checks, excluding lifts/motors. One requested detail, 2026 Harris Cruiser 190 SL (stock URL ending 13466402i), returned HTTP 403; its inventory summary was retained and the denial was not bypassed.
sources.nextAction: Keep the dated partial-detail warning and unknown specifications for that ad. Use a permitted dealer feed or reviewed manual evidence for the missing detail; do not bypass the 403. La Porte city centroid is Census-reviewed, while exact boat storage and seller availability remain unverified.

sources.name: Quest Watersports, Ottawa
sources.observation: Dealer page and its public inventory script/response pass robots and HTTP 200. Response has 9 items: 7 boats after excluding a boat lift and paired PWCs. Actual-response adapter, fixtures and quality gate pass.
sources.nextAction: Enabled via the same public inventory endpoint used by dealer HTML; paginate in 24-item increments if inventory grows. Source availability and lake eligibility still require confirmation.

sources.name: Boat Works, Keyesport IL
sources.observation: Robots, inventory and detail HTTP 200. Fixture-tested adapter parses 18 boats from 33 items; 9 report length <=21 ft and >=200 hp, including Phoenix, Nitro, Ranger and Skeeter. Location outside core area; city cache pending.
sources.nextAction: Disabled wider-region profile is ready to enable deliberately; use listing-specific length/engine verification before travelling.

sources.name: The Boat Center, Chippewa Falls WI / Minnesota
sources.observation: Robots and first 2 inventory pages HTTP 200. Fixture-tested adapter parses 20 stock ads in this sample; page links expose 14 pages. Known engine power and branch state retained; summary lengths mostly unknown; incoming stock labeled.
sources.nextAction: Disabled wider-region profile supports bounded linked pagination; enable only for wider search. Detail-length enrichment and current onsite availability remain source gaps.
